free_tier.stated: keyless GET /ipgeo/{ip} returns country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, currency, ISP, ASN and proxy and hosting flags as JSON; a lookup of 8.8.8.8 answered HTTP 200 with no key, no account and no credit card
free_tier.notes: unverified: no request quota, rate limit or terms page is published on the host; a public API directory describes it as unlimited and free.

per_object_cap.stated: one IP address per request, in the URL path

retention.stated: not applicable: a lookup API; answers are cached for 900 seconds (cache-control max-age=900; cached true in the body)

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://api.techniknews.net/ipgeo/{ip} answers JSON with Access-Control-Allow-Origin *; the host root lists IP, IPgeo, Radiodata and Speedtest endpoints
tooling: any HTTP client; the JSON field names follow the ip-api.com shape (status, country, countryCode, regionName, city, zip, lat, lon, timezone, isp, org, as)
chaining: Free keyless IP to location, ISP, ASN and hosting-flag lookups with no published quota; one IP per call. Bulk path: none listed.

limits.value: unverified: no rate limit or quota is published on the host

binding_note: no limit is published, so none could be named; the service caches answers for 900 seconds.

identity_cost.detail: no key, account or header: a plain GET answered HTTP 200

reliability_note: a lookup of 8.8.8.8 answered HTTP 200 in about 560 ms and the answer was served from a cache (cached true); no rate-limit header is returned
confidence_note: One keyless lookup of 8.8.8.8 was probed on 2026-11-02 and the host root page was read; no quota, rate limit or terms page exists on the host, so those values stay unverified.

a keyless GET of /ipgeo/8.8.8.8 answered HTTP 200
the answer carries a location with country and country code
the answer carries ISP, organisation and ASN
the answer carries mobile, proxy and hosting flags
the answer is served from a cache with a cache timestamp
the answer is cacheable for 900 seconds
a third-party API directory describes the endpoint as an unlimited free IP address API
